# Hard-tier names that became aliases of a type in another package, keeping their name and every source use.
#
# scripts/apidiff_check.sh treats exactly two apidiff lines for a listed entry as compatible: "NAME: changed from NAME to
# <module>/PATH.NAME", and a Hard-tier method whose signature text is unchanged and names NAME, because only that type's identity
# moved (decoder's (*Model).Config). Every other incompatible change to a Hard-tier name stays fatal. What an alias does change,
# a value's %T and reflect String/PkgPath (and so gob's names), is stated in docs/api-tiers.md.
#
# EACH ENTRY IS FRANCIS'S CALL, recorded with who decided and when. Never add one to make the gate pass.
#
# Format: <pkg> <name> = <package path below the module>.<name>   # decided by, date

decoder Config = decoder/config.Config   # Francis, 2026-11-07 11:49 (DC1b, docs/tasks/task-decoder-config-2026-11.md)
